_comment: Bundle B0 capability-correctness A/B (experiment 004). Each model appears twice: an -A agent (context_effect_summary:true — the helpers' effect_summary is injected into initial problem.md) and a -B agent (false — withheld). Replace agents[].cmd with your real agent CLIs (same wrapper used by the e001/codex/gemini campaigns). The -A/-B delta in capability-adherence (scripts/score_capability.py) is the B0 verdict. Requires the prepare_run.py context_effect_summary hook (see experiments/004-capability-bounded-summarize.md, Harness wiring).
